editions.headline: The store is no longer the demo. Engine shipped the loop.
editions.dek: Top 5 across vendors and papers. Judgment first. Sources remain the authority.

ranks.title: LangSmith Engine is now the product to beat
ranks.html: The 25 Aug post is not a new toy. Engine (May beta) now claims >2× issue detection on IssueBench, +25% on Terminal-Bench for proposed fixes, Slack/Linear, Reduced Analysis, and self-hosted orchestration in the customer VPC (inference via LangSmith Intelligence, ZDR). Same job as Arize Signal (GA 29 Jul, Enterprise PRs, promo through 15 Sep). Judgment: BQAA still wins governed SQL and business joins. It loses the 2026 demo. Package a named trace→cluster→dataset loop on AI.GENERATE or customers will buy Engine for the narrative while data sits in BigQuery. The 2× figure is first-party; verification of proposed fixes is still unshipped.

ranks.title: UModel: warehouse as entity graph, not raw SQL
ranks.html: Pei et al., arXiv 2606.04799 (June 2026, Alibaba Cloud production: millions of ops/s). Remodels metrics/logs/traces as objects (EntitySet, DataLink) plus a pipe language. Agents calling raw PromQL/SQL sit under 5% query accuracy; entity PaaS tools add +8 pts RCA and +21–27 vs writing SPL from scratch. Judgment: this is the closest architecture analog to BQAA. Do not ship “here is agent_events, write SQL” as the agent interface. Expose analyze_golden_metric(entity)-style tools on top of the table. UModel is the consume-layer design doc the SDK still does not have.

ranks.title: LongRCA: production RCA is still unsolved
ranks.html: Zhang, Feng, Pei et al., arXiv 2608.15242 (Aug 2026). 1,140 natural failed traces, median 145 steps, max 728. Score responsible role and exact root step independently. Best method: 51.1% role / 24.1% exact root. Human agreement on exact step is 39.5%. Injected-error benches overstate. Judgment: this should gate #435. A 6-week EvalBench MVP that only does session-level labels on a short warehouse benchmark is fine as a start; do not claim span-level forensics until you beat LongRCA-like length. Store role, step_idx, handoff_from/to, root_to_end_distance.

ranks.title: Langfuse v4 is the missed platform ship
ranks.html: v4 GA 17 Aug. Observations-first ClickHouse model (append-only events_full, no read-time join/dedup). Cloud becomes v4-only on 16 Nov 2026. Self-host v3 patches through Jan 2027. Claimed: table loads seconds→ms; long-range dashboards ≥10× on large projects. No Engine/Signal equivalent. Judgment: this is the self-host / data-residency answer to SaaS trace stores, not a fixer agent. If you pitch BQAA vs Langfuse, argue warehouse joins and retention, not query latency. Mark 16 Nov on the calendar.

ranks.title: Amplitude published the privacy contract for Agent Analytics
ranks.html: GA 20 Aug on every plan, including free. 28 Aug (inside 72h) names the modes: full / metadata_only / customer_enriched, plus RBAC, hashed tool schemas, session-safety classes. The pitch is shared user_id with product events: failed task → 30-day retention. Caps: 5k–20k sessions/month; chat retained 14 or 30 days. Judgment: they own the phrase “agent analytics” for PMs. Threat is the business-join story, not debugging. Productize BQAA’s Looker/SQL joins as that loop, or Amplitude will sell it to the same Google customers.

desk.title: SDK 0.5.1 and #435 plan v4, tonight
desk.html: 0.5.1 at 19:50 PT: EvalBench reader, canonical rubrics, golden matching 0.92. #435 comments through 20:21 PT iterated the RFC to a 6-week EvalBench-only MVP. Reviewers flagged SANA (arXiv 2606.13904) as adjacent. Do not start the clock until P1s and partner/job are named.

desk.title: Who&When Pro is the failure enum to steal
desk.html: arXiv 2607.09996 (10 Jul): 12,326 traces, 18-mode taxonomy, golden who/when/why. Frontier models ~74% text-step accuracy, ~22% error-mode F1. Planning/coordination collapse into “reasoning.” Use the taxonomy in #435; do not trust injected labels as a production prior.

desk.title: Tuned Evaluators / Perceived Error
desk.html: 18 Aug. Managed judge on threads, 12-hour lag, US Plus/Enterprise, 82% cheaper than frontier on their bench. This is the cheap production score Engine needs. BQAA’s GraderPipeline is the warehouse version — still batch, not attached to the live row.

open.title: OTel GenAI still 0/63 stable
open.html: Dedicated repo, no tagged release as of 21 Aug. Python instrumentation flip silently blanks old dashboards. “OTel-native” in Aug 2026 is a Development convention.

open.title: OpenAI Evals export 31 Oct / shutdown 30 Nov
open.html: Unchanged. Forced migration to Promptfoo / Braintrust / LangSmith / BQAA. Oct 31 is the date that matters.

open.title: Arize Signal promo ends 15 Sep
open.html: Enterprise managed agents at no extra charge through 15 Sep. Commercial clock on the Engine/Signal race.

open.title: Looker Studio template still FAILING
open.html: #445 closed; external-access contract not green. Grafana is the documented alternative.

open.title: AgentProcessBench FirstErrAcc
open.html: KDD 2026 / 2603.14465: 8,509 human ternary step labels. FirstErrAcc is the judge SLO (81.6% StepAcc vs 65.8% FirstErrAcc on Gemini-3-Flash-Thinking). Warehouse process-score columns.

editions.headline: Trace-to-fix agents are the product now
editions.dek: Five things that actually moved. The brief directs attention; the source remains the authority.

ranks.title: Trace-to-fix agents are the product now
ranks.html: LangSmith Engine (May beta; 25 Aug claims >2× issue detection, including self-hosted) and Arize Signal / Managed Agents (GA 29 Jul) cluster production traces and open PRs. The store is no longer the demo.

ranks.title: Databricks is the only warehouse peer
ranks.html: OTel traces into Unity Catalog Delta via Zerobus, SQL scorers, UC ACLs. Same pitch: join traces to business data; don’t send prompts to a SaaS.

ranks.title: OTel GenAI is still Development
ranks.html: Conventions moved to semantic-conventions-genai (repo 5 May; core v1.42.0 on 12 Jun stripped gen_ai.*). Production mixes v1.36 and v1.37+ names. BQAA still does not export OTel spans; it joins on trace_id.

ranks.title: Amplitude claimed the name
ranks.html: Product analytics on conversations this month: funnels, retention, identity. Not a trace debugger. That’s the business-insights story packaged as a product.

ranks.title: AER is the closest paper to BQAA
ranks.html: Oracle AER (Vispute & Kadam, Mar 2026) treats population-level behavioral analytics as a first-class schema (intent / observation / inference), not NLP over traces. Empirical validation still preliminary. Then IBM ABBench. Failure taxonomies: TRAIL / MAST / Who&When (step-level RCA ~14%). Yehudai et al., Findings of ACL 2026 is the survey that says developer eval frameworks cannot aggregate across large run collections.

desk.title: SDK 0.5.1 landed ~19:50 PT
desk.html: EvalBench reader, 8-metric rubrics, golden matching at 0.92. Consume SDK, not the capture plugin.

desk.title: #435 is an open RFC, not a PR
desk.html: AgentForensics failure taxonomy. Plan v3 is a 6-week EvalBench-only session-level MVP. Last review: do not start the clock until the P1s are closed.
